# Weave v{{VERSION}}

Installer and project tool for [MayaFlux](https://github.com/MayaFlux/MayaFlux).

Weave installs MayaFlux, creates projects with CMake presets
and optional live coding support, and registers community modules.
Each project includes a `validate` script for diagnostics. Weave reads and
validates the dependencies a community module declares but does not install
them; install those with your package manager.
Download the file for your platform below.
